title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
subtitle: 100% completion checklist
disclaimer: Unofficial fan-made checklist. Not affiliated with, endorsed or sponsored by KONAMI. Castlevania is a trademark of KONAMI.
news: Added outfits, the classic code, the secret arena and backtracking chests.

categories.name: Explore every area
categories.note: Each area shows its own completion percentage in the game. 1,765 completion parts across all 9 areas.

items.detail: 319 completion parts: rooms, items, doors and more.

categories.name: Bosses
categories.note: 14 bosses across 18 fights (four are fought twice). Some are optional, but the true ending needs them all. One early clash can't be won and doesn't count.

items.name: Bosses defeated 4/14
items.detail: Keep hunting. Some bosses are optional.

items.name: Bosses defeated 8/14
items.detail: Keep hunting. Some bosses are optional.

items.name: Bosses defeated 12/14
items.detail: Keep hunting. Some bosses are optional.

items.name: All 14 bosses defeated
items.detail: Every boss down. Earlier versions of this list said 16.

items.name: Win all 18 boss fights
items.detail: Includes the four rematches. Notre-Dame has the most.

items.name: Every weapon
items.detail: All 28 weapons: 7 types with 4 each.

items.name: A weapon from each of the 7 families
Get a Legendary weapon
items.detail: Rarity tiers go Ordinary, Refined, Masterpiece, Legendary.

items.name: Get a Masterpiece weapon
items.detail: The tier just below Legendary.

items.name: A Legendary weapon in all 7 families
Own all 7 outfits
items.detail: 1 default, 3 you can earn, 3 from editions or pre-order. Outfits don't count toward 100%.

items.name: Earn the 3 free outfits
items.detail: One from a classic code, one from an ending, one from a secret duel in Notre-Dame.

items.name: All 44 Relics
items.detail: Per the latest detailed guides: 18 in Paris, 26 in the castle. 41 have effects and 3 Eyes only open a door; one is a Midnight Edition bonus. Early guides said 40. You can equip 3 at once.

items.name: All stat upgrades
items.detail: 48 heart fragments and 28 stat books in all.

items.name: All 24 Brave heart fragments
items.detail: Every 4 raise max HP.

items.name: All 24 Wise heart fragments
items.detail: Every 4 raise max MP.

items.name: All 34 Mirrors of Life
items.detail: Activating them all earns a trophy.

items.name: All 40 clues
items.detail: Finding every clue earns a trophy.

items.name: Every Tarot Card complete
items.detail: 15 cards to collect, plus the one you start with.

items.name: Every Arcana levelled
items.detail: All 42 Gifts across the 15 collected Arcana.

items.name: Learn all 15 spells
items.detail: Guides count spells separately from Arcana cards. Per early guides; the total may change.

categories.name: Secrets & trophy goals
categories.note: 30 trophies on PlayStation (29 achievements elsewhere). Turn Custom Mode off: it can block some of them.

items.name: Reveal every map room
items.detail: More than 1,300 rooms.

items.name: Survive all 5 Haunted Coffin encounters
items.detail: All in the cemetery.

items.name: Open the chest sealed by the Haunted Coffins
items.detail: Unseals once all 5 coffins are cleared; the relic inside gives you a bat companion.

items.name: Ring all 4 virtue bells in Notre-Dame
items.detail: Each needs its matching spell equipped.

items.name: Solve the hidden-roof riddle in the Master's Quarters
Open the Gate of Flesh
items.detail: Needs all three Eye relics.

items.name: Enter the classic code on the main menu
items.detail: The famous up-up-down-down code unlocks an outfit.

items.name: Find the secret arena
items.detail: Holds a Legendary fist weapon.

items.name: Go back for the chests you couldn't reach
items.detail: Several areas hide weapon chests that need later moves such as Double Jump. Grab any boss-room drop before leaving.

items.name: Destroy 666 candles
items.detail: 1,538 in the whole castle.

items.name: Finish a regular enemy with Holy Cross while holding a whip
Beat the game in under 4 hours
items.detail: Needs its own run. Check the play time on the System tab.

items.name: Unlock every trophy
items.detail: Or all 29 achievements on Xbox and Steam.

items.name: Bad ending
items.detail: There are three endings in all.

items.name: Normal ending
items.detail: About 12 hours for most players.

items.name: True ending
items.detail: Needed for 100%, and for the last area to count.

items.name: 100% game completion
items.detail: The Progress percentage on the System tab reads 100%.
